description: v2 split policy. v2 adds: cross-scenario-family split track, visibility-stratified track, implementation-family (not just policy-code) isolation for cross-policy, and automated zero-leakage verification. All split generation runs before baseline training; OOD test sets are hashed and sealed.
changelog_v2: Cross-policy now isolates by implementation family, not just policy code
Automatic zero-leakage verification: episode_id, scenario_family, controller_family, participant_pair, derived_seed_family must not cross splits
OOD test sets locked and hashed before baseline training

global_constraints.grouping_rule: All segments derived from the same grouping_unit must reside in the SAME split. No grouping_unit may appear in more than one split.

tracks.name: In-distribution random split
tracks.description: Standard IID split. Episodes are grouped by scenario_family first, then randomly assigned. Entire episode stays in one split.

tracks.name: Cross-map generalization
tracks.description: Map families seen in training are held out of test. Test uses only unseen map families. Train/val split within seen maps.

tracks.name: Cross-policy / cross-controller generalization
tracks.description: Controller implementation families isolated: policies sharing the same codebase/architecture stay together. Test uses unseen controller families. Isolation is by IMPLEMENTATION FAMILY, not policy code alone.

tracks.name: Cross-scenario-family generalization
tracks.description: Entire scenario families held out of training. Tests whether model generalizes to unseen scenario configurations.

tracks.name: Visibility-stratified evaluation
tracks.description: Episodes stratified by average entity visibility for the evaluated side. Tests model robustness to observation degradation. Each visibility bin must be represented in all splits.

checks: No scenario_family appears in more than one split
No controller_implementation_family appears in more than one split
No participant_pair appears in more than one split
No seed-derived episode appears in a different split than its parent seed
Auto-generated verification: run before every baseline training run

remediation.leakage_detected: Re-run split generation with updated grouping or re-seeded random state
remediation.metadata_high_accuracy: If metadata-only baseline significantly exceeds random, flag data for re-sampling or split-grouping revision

implementation_family_policy.description: Cross-policy isolation uses implementation family, not just policy code. Implementation family is defined by the underlying model architecture and training regime, not by the policy rollout code.
